categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Matches the Utils/log/libs label and directly modifies the shared logging utility LogEscapeMessage.
categories.rationale: Fixes a security hole where UTF-8 encoded C1 control characters bypass log escaping and allow terminal command execution in VTE-based terminals. The description notes that emulators such as GNOME Terminal decode these sequences as CSI, OSC, and DCS, exposing users viewing logs to untrusted input execution.
